# Plan: Dual-eye GC9D01 support (lcdtest go)

## Context
Single left-eye LCD is working. Now add right-eye GC9D01 with different GPIO pins.
Both eyes share backlight (P25) and power supply (P52). Need to parameterise the
bit-bang SPI functions so they can drive either panel.

## Pin assignments

| Signal | Left eye | Right eye |
|--------|----------|-----------|
| SCLK   | GPIO_2   | GPIO_22   |
| CS     | GPIO_3   | GPIO_23   |
| MOSI   | GPIO_4   | GPIO_24   |
| DC     | GPIO_5   | GPIO_7    |
| RST    | GPIO_29  | GPIO_6    |
| BL     | GPIO_25  | (shared)  |

## Changes to `nuttx/arch/arm/src/bk7258/bk7258_gc9d01.c`

### 1. Define pin struct and instances (after defines)

```c
typedef struct {
  int sclk;
  int cs;
  int mosi;
  int dc;
  int rst;
} lcd_pins_t;

static const lcd_pins_t g_lcd_left  = { 2, 3, 4, 5, 29 };
static const lcd_pins_t g_lcd_right = { 22, 23, 24, 7, 6 };
static const lcd_pins_t *g_active_pins = &g_lcd_left;
```

### 2. Add `lcd_set_pins()` helper

```c
static void lcd_set_pins(const lcd_pins_t *pins)
{
  g_active_pins = pins;
}
```

### 3. Parameterise SPI functions

Replace all `LCD_PIN_SCLK/CS/MOSI/DC/RST` in these functions with `g_active_pins->sclk/cs/mosi/dc/rst`:

- `spi_write_byte()` — MOSI, SCLK
- `lcd_send_cmd()` — DC, CS
- `lcd_send_data()` — DC, CS
- `lcd_fill_rect()` — DC, CS (the inline data path at lines 325-333)
- `lcd_init_sequence()` — no direct pin refs (uses send_cmd/send_data)
- `lcd_display_on()` — no direct pin refs

### 4. Add `lcd_setup_pins()` helper

Configures the active panel's SPI pins as outputs with idle levels:
```c
static void lcd_setup_pins(const lcd_pins_t *pins)
{
  lcd_set_pins(pins);
  gpio_set_output(pins->sclk);
  gpio_set_output(pins->cs);
  gpio_set_output(pins->mosi);
  gpio_set_output(pins->dc);
  gpio_set_output(pins->rst);
  gpio_write(pins->cs, 1);
  gpio_write(pins->dc, 1);
  gpio_write(pins->sclk, 0);
  gpio_write(pins->mosi, 0);
}
```

### 5. Rewrite `lcdtest_go()` — dual-eye

```
step1   GPIO 0-52 high (skip: 2,3,4,5,6,7,22,23,24,25,29 both-eye pins,
                        10,11 UART, 20,21 SWD, 38,39 LEDs)
step2   up_mdelay(500)
step3   backlight P25 high

--- left eye ---
step4   [left] SPI pins setup
step5   [left] RST + init(display_off)
step6   [left] fill black
step7   [left] fill 40x40 red at (60,60)
step8   [left] display on

--- right eye ---
step9   [right] SPI pins setup
step10  [right] RST + init(display_off)
step11  [right] fill black
step12  [right] fill 40x40 blue at (60,60)
step13  [right] display on
```

Each step prints `[go] stepN [left/right]: ...`.

### 6. Update `lcdtest_stages()` (Stage B)

Use `lcd_setup_pins(&g_lcd_left)` instead of manual pin config.
Stage A/C stay as-is (backlight is shared, Stage C only touches left eye).

### 7. Update `lcdtest_pwr()` skip list

Add right-eye pins (6, 7, 22, 23, 24) to the skip list alongside left-eye pins.

### 8. Update `lcdtest_scan()` skip list

Add right-eye pins to the "LCD signal" skip condition.

### 9. Keep old subcommands

`scan`, `pwr`, default (stages) unchanged in dispatcher.

187	 *
188	 ****************************************************************************/
189	
190	static void audio_init(void)
191	{
192	  uint32_t val;
193	
194	  /* Step 0: SYS audio clock enable (BEFORE any AUD register access).
195	   * cksel_aud = 0 → XTAL (26 MHz), aud_cken = 1.
196	   * Without this the AUD engine has no clock and FIFO stays empty.
197	   */
198	
199	  val = aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_CLK_DIV_MODE1);
200	  val &= ~SYS_CKSEL_AUD;
201	  aud_putreg(val, SYS_CPU_CLK_DIV_MODE1);
202	
203	  val = aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_DEVICE_CLK_ENABLE);
204	  val |= SYS_AUD_CKEN;
205	  aud_putreg(val, SYS_CPU_DEVICE_CLK_ENABLE);
206	
207	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] SYS aud clock: CLK_DIV=0x%08lx DEV_CLK=0x%08lx\n",
208	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_CLK_DIV_MODE1),
209	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_DEVICE_CLK_ENABLE));
210	
211	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] init: clock + soft reset\n");
212	
213	  /* Step 1: Enable audio APB clock gate.
214	   * AUD_CLK_CONTROL bit[1] = 0 to enable clock.
215	   */
216	
217	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_CLK_CONTROL);
218	  val &= ~AUD_ADC_CLK_GATE;
219	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CLK_CONTROL);
220	
221	  /* Step 2: Soft reset the audio digital block */
222	
223	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_CLK_CONTROL);
224	  val |= AUD_ADC_SOFT_RESET;
225	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CLK_CONTROL);
226	  up_mdelay(1);
227	  val &= ~AUD_ADC_SOFT_RESET;
228	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CLK_CONTROL);
229	
230	  /* Step 3: Select XTAL clock (APLL not supported on BK7258) */
231	
232	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_CONFIG);
233	  val &= ~AUD_APLL_SEL;
234	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CONFIG);
235	
236	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] init: analog power + mic bias\n");
237	
238	  /* Step 4: Enable audio bias, ADC bias, mic bias (ANA_REG18) */
239	
240	  val = aud_getreg(ANA_REG18);
241	  val |= ANA_ENAUDBIAS | ANA_ENADCBIAS | ANA_ENMICBIAS;
242	  aud_putreg(val, ANA_REG18);
243	
244	  /* Step 5: Enable MIC1 (ANA_REG19 bit[28]) */
245	
246	  val = aud_getreg(ANA_REG19);
247	  val |= ANA_MICEN;
248	  aud_putreg(val, ANA_REG19);
249	
250	  /* Step 6: Enable MIC2 (ANA_REG27 — BK7258 specific) */
251	
252	  aud_putreg(0x91800006, ANA_REG27);
253	
254	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] init: differential mode + mic reset\n");
255	
256	  /* Step 7: Differential mode — ANA_REG19 bit[13] = 0 (default) */
257	
258	  val = aud_getreg(ANA_REG19);
259	  val &= ~ANA_MIC_SINGLE_EN;
260	  aud_putreg(val, ANA_REG19);
261	
262	  /* Also set ANA_REG20 diffen for good measure */
263	
264	  val = aud_getreg(ANA_REG20);
265	  val |= ANA_DIFFEN;
266	  aud_putreg(val, ANA_REG20);
267	
268	  /* Step 8: MIC reset pulse */
269	
270	  val = aud_getreg(ANA_REG19);
271	  val |= ANA_MIC_RST;
272	  aud_putreg(val, ANA_REG19);
273	  up_mdelay(10);
274	  val &= ~ANA_MIC_RST;
275	  aud_putreg(val, ANA_REG19);
276	
277	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] init: ADC config\n");
278	
279	  /* Step 9: ADC digital config — gain 0dB, bypass HPF, rising edge */
280	
281	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_ADC_CONFIG_0);
282	  val &= ~AUD_ADC_GAIN_MASK;
283	  val |= AUD_ADC_GAIN_0DB;
284	  val &= ~AUD_ADC_EDGE;
285	  val |= AUD_ADC_HPF1_BYP | AUD_ADC_HPF2_BYP;
286	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_ADC_CONFIG_0);
287	
288	  /* Step 10: Sample rate 16kHz, XTAL fixed divider */
289	
290	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_CONFIG);
291	  val &= ~AUD_RATE_ADC_MASK;
292	  val |= AUD_RATE_ADC_16K;
293	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CONFIG);
294	
295	  /* Disable ADC fractional divider (use fixed path) */
296	
297	  val = aud_getreg(AUD_EXTEND_CFG);
298	  val &= ~AUD_ADC_FRAC_MANUAL;
299	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_EXTEND_CFG);

301	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] init: enable ADC\n");
302	
303	  /* Step 11: Enable ADC + line-in */
304

306	  val |= AUD_ADC_ENABLE | AUD_LINEIN_ENABLE;
307	  aud_putreg(val, AUD_CONFIG);
308	
309	  up_mdelay(50);
310	
311	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] init done\n");

349	 *
350	 * Description:
351	 *   Poll ADC FIFO and capture N sample pairs (L+R interleaved).
352	 *   Each AUD_ADC_FIFO_PORT read returns L in [15:0], R in [31:16].
353	 *
354	 ****************************************************************************/
355	
356	static int audio_capture(int n)
357	{
358	  int count = 0;
359	  uint32_t status;
360	  uint32_t sample;
361	  uint32_t spin_sample;
362	  uint32_t spin_total = 0;
363	
364	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] capturing %d samples ...\n", n);
365	
366	  while (count < n)
367	    {
368	      /* Per-sample spin with timeout */
369	
370	      spin_sample = 0;
371	
372	      for (;;)
373	        {
374	          status = aud_getreg(AUD_FIFO_STATUS);
375	
376	          if (!(status & AUD_ADC_FIFO_EMPTY))
377	            {
378	              break;
379	            }
380	
381	          if (++spin_sample >= FIFO_SPIN_LIMIT)
382	            {
383	              /* Timeout on this sample — bail out with diagnostics */
384	
385	              goto timeout;
386	            }
387	        }
388	
389	      sample = aud_getreg(AUD_ADC_FIFO_PORT);
390	      g_mic_left[count]  = (int16_t)(sample & 0xffff);
391	      g_mic_right[count] = (int16_t)((sample >> 16) & 0xffff);
392	      count++;
393	
394	      spin_total += spin_sample;
395	
396	      if (spin_total >= TOTAL_SPIN_CAP)
397	        {
398	          goto timeout;
399	        }
400	    }
401	
402	  syslog(LOG_INFO, "[mic] capture done: %d pairs\n", count);
403	  return count;

412	         count,
413	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(AUD_FIFO_STATUS),
414	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(AUD_CONFIG),
415	         (unsigned long)aud_getreg(SYS_CPU_CLK_DIV_MODE1),

428	static float compute_rms(const int16_t *buf, int n)
429	{
430	  double sum = 0.0;
431	  int i;
432	
433	  for (i = 0; i < n; i++)
434	    {
435	      sum += (double)buf[i] * (double)buf[i];
436	    }
437	
438	  return (float)sqrt(sum / n);
